instruction: Run command-line automation through the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment and CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. For the steps below, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\hole_recognition_part.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Recognize the twenty-four holes and group them into through holes, blind holes, counterbores, and threaded holes. Create spot drill, drill, bore or circle mill, and thread milling toolpaths for the groups using the supplied tool data. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-13.nc.
